technique_remarks: 'استعمل انه مكان حالة ... لاجل الجناس ليصعب حلها' - 'he used 'annahu' [innahu] in place of 'halatu' ... for the sake of the paronomasia (jinas) to make it hard to solve' - the plaintext was deliberately written to make decipherment harder by puns (jinas); 'فيهما جناس انه وانه ولان العتاب يفهم منه بانفراده الحزن' - 'in the two there is jinas (annahu/innahu) and because the reproach implies grief'. 'ما كتبنا تحتها' - 'what we wrote under it' [doubtful]. The anecdote of f. 71v is completed: Ibn al-Wardi tells the compiler the dulab verses are his own and that he had not circulated them, so the compiler's choosing them as plaintext surprised him. No dated remark, no AH year.
